column10: ESTABLISHED WITH A CAUSE, the best documented case in the set. Skuttunge had a detached north-western part at Lake Tamnaren in 1882, and the 1910 note names the cause: the division of Balinge harads allmanning among the farms of all the parishes of the hundred, which made the Akerby/Jumkil/Balinge/Skuttunge boundaries 'i hogsta matto oregelbundna'. A proposal to place the pieces of the former hundred common in the parishes they lie in was refused on 1893-04-07. The division is already 'forna haradsallmanningen' in 1910 and so predates 1882; its year was not found. A partial regulation followed on 1972-01-01, when an uninhabited area went from Skuttunge to Balinge (SCB, Folkmangd 31 december 1971), so the exclave survived a 20th-century tidying-up. The same cause covers the small Akerby exclaves in Balinge and Jumkil.
